newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts hotel companies.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts hotel companies.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said on Tuesday it had started coverage of hotel companies FelCor Suite Hotels Inc, Patriot American Hospitality Inc and Hospitality Properties Trust.
-- Analyst Eric Hemel rated Felcor as near-term neutral and long-term accumulate. He rated Hospitality Properties as a near-term buy and a long-term accumulate.
-- He rated Patriot American as a near-term accumulate and a long-term buy.
-- Felcor's shares closed on Monday at 36-5/8, near a 12-month high, and Hospitality Properties closed at 28-3/8. Patriot American closed at 48-1/4. also near a year's high.
